title: Design: Credit Limit locks at $0.00 for COD on New Customer
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Net 30 is the default for new customers.
  • Starting screen: the Customers page.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide, at 100% zoom.
    For example: a maximised window on a 1440 x 900 screen.
  • The design picture ct-p5-04-new-customer-cod-picked-limit-locked-at-0.png is attached to this case; open it at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Customer".
  2. Choose "COD" in Credit Terms.
  3. Hover Credit Limit.
  4. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the "New Customer" window opens.
  • Step 2: Credit Limit reads "$ 0.00" in grey on a light-grey, greyed box.
  • Step 3: a dark grey box opens under the field reading "COD and Credit Hold customers can't charge to account, so they have no credit limit." (as in ct-p5-04-new-customer-cod-picked-limit-locked-at-0.png).
  • Step 4: at 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll; the layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11674 (Story 5, New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • S5-R4: “When the chosen term is COD or Credit Hold, Credit Limit shows $0.00 and is disabled; hovering it shows "COD and Credit Hold customers can't charge to account, so they have no credit limit." Choosing COD or Credit Hold sets the limit to $0.00.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Hover the locked Credit Limit (COD or Credit Hold) | "COD and Credit Hold customers can't charge to account, so they have no credit limit." | Tooltip on hover”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "5 New Customer" ("New Customer: COD picked, limit locked at $0"). Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the PRD quotes, except where this held design case follows the design.

  • “Picking COD or Credit Hold sets Credit Limit to $0 and disables it (DS disabled input). Hover: "COD and Credit Hold customers can't charge to account, so they have no credit limit."”
